name: Svargarohana Parva

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
svargaM triviShTapaM prApya mama pUrvapitAmahAH |
pANDavA dhArtarAShTrAshcha kAni sthAnAni bhejire
shlokas.2:
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM sarvavichchAsi me mataH |
maharShiNAbhyanuj~nAto vyAsenAdbhutakarmaNA
shlokas.3:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
svargaM triviShTapaM prApya tava pUrvapitAmahAH |
yudhiShThiraprabhRRitayo yadakurvata tachChRRiNu
shlokas.4:
svargaM triviShTapaM prApya dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
duryodhanaM shriyA juShTaM dadarshAsInamAsane
shlokas.5:
bhrAjamAnamivAdityaM vIralakShmyAbhisa.nvRRitam |
devairbhrAjiShNubhiH sAdhyaiH sahitaM puNyakarmabhiH
shlokas.6:
tato yudhiShThiro dRRiShTvA duryodhanamamarShitaH |
sahasA saMnivRRitto.abhUchChriyaM dRRiShTvA suyodhane
shlokas.7:
bruvannuchchairvachastAnvai nAhaM duryodhanena vai |
sahitaH kAmaye lokA.NllubdhenAdIrghadarshinA
shlokas.8:
yatkRRite pRRithivI sarvA suhRRido bAndhavAstathA |
hatAsmAbhiH prasahyAjau kliShTaiH pUrvaM mahAvane
shlokas.9:
draupadI cha sabhAmadhye pA~nchAlI dharmachAriNI |
parikliShTAnavadyA~NgI patnI no gurusaMnidhau
shlokas.10:
svasti devA na me kAmaH suyodhanamudIkShitum |
tatrAhaM gantumichChAmi yatra te bhrAtaro mama
shlokas.11:
maivamityabravIttaM tu nAradaH prahasanniva |
svarge nivAso rAjendra viruddhaM chApi nashyati
shlokas.12:
yudhiShThira mahAbAho maivaM vochaH katha~nchana |
duryodhanaM prati nRRipaM shRRiNu chedaM vacho mama
shlokas.13:
eSha duryodhano rAjA pUjyate tridashaiH saha |
sadbhishcha rAjapravarairya ime svargavAsinaH
shlokas.14:
vIralokagatiM prApto yuddhe hutvAtmanastanum |
yUyaM sarve surasamA yena yuddhe samAsitAH
shlokas.15:
sa eSha kShatradharmeNa sthAnametadavAptavAn |
bhaye mahati yo.abhIto babhUva pRRithivIpatiH
shlokas.16:
na tanmanasi kartavyaM putra yaddyUtakAritam |
draupadyAshcha parikleshaM na chintayatumarhasi
shlokas.17:
ye chAnye.api parikleshA yuShmAkaM dyUtakAritAH |
sa~NgrAmeShvatha vAnyatra na tAnsa.nsmartumarhasi
shlokas.18:
samAgachCha yathAnyAyaM rAj~nA duryodhanena vai |
svargo.ayaM neha vairANi bhavanti manujAdhipa
shlokas.19:
nAradenaivamuktastu kururAjo yudhiShThiraH |
bhrAtR^InpaprachCha medhAvI vAkyametaduvAcha ha
shlokas.20:
yadi duryodhanasyaite vIralokAH sanAtanAH |
adharmaj~nasya pApasya pRRithivIsuhRRidadruhaH
shlokas.21:
yatkRRite pRRithivI naShTA sahayA sarathadvipA |
vayaM cha manyunA dagdhA vairaM pratichikIrShavaH
shlokas.22:
ye te vIrA mahAtmAno bhrAtaro me mahAvratAH |
satyapratij~nA lokasya shUrA vai satyavAdinaH
shlokas.23:
teShAmidAnIM ke lokA draShTumichChAmi tAnaham |
karNaM chaiva mahAtmAnaM kaunteyaM satyasa~Ngaram
shlokas.24:
dhRRiShTadyumnaM sAtyakiM cha dhRRiShTadyumnasya chAtmajAn |
ye cha shastrairvadhaM prAptAH kShatradharmeNa pArthivAH
shlokas.25:
kva nu te pArthivA brahmannaitAnpashyAmi nArada |
virATadrupadau chaiva dhRRiShTaketumukhA.nshcha tAn
shlokas.26:
shikhaNDinaM cha pA~nchAlyaM draupadeyA.nshcha sarvashaH |
abhimanyuM cha durdharShaM draShTumichChAmi nArada

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
neha pashyAmi vibudhA rAdheyamamitaujasam |
bhrAtarau cha mahAtmAnau yudhAmanyUttamaujasau
shlokas.2:
juhuvurye sharIrANi raNavahnau mahArathAH |
rAjAno rAjaputrAshcha ye madarthe hatA raNe
shlokas.3:
kva te mahArathAH sarve shArdUlasamavikramAH |
tairapyayaM jito lokaH kachchitpuruShasattamaiH
shlokas.4:
yadi lokAnimAnprAptAste cha sarve mahArathAH |
sthitaM vitta hi mAM devAH sahitaM tairmahAtmabhiH
shlokas.5:
kachchinna tairavApto.ayaM nRRipairloko.akShayaH shubhaH |
na tairahaM vinA vatsye j~nAtibhirbhrAtRRibhistathA
shlokas.6:
mAturhi vachanaM shrutvA tadA salilakarmaNi |
karNasya kriyatAM toyamiti tapyAmi tena vai
shlokas.7:
idaM cha paritapyAmi punaH punarahaM surAH |
yanmAtuH sadRRishau pAdau tasyAhamamitaujasaH
shlokas.8:
dRRiShTvaiva taM nAnugataH karNaM parabalArdanam |
na hyasmAnkarNasahitA~njayechChakro.api sa.nyuge
shlokas.9:
tamahaM yatratatrasthaM draShTumichChAmi sUryajam |
avij~nAto mayA yo.asau ghAtitaH savyasAchinA
shlokas.10:
bhImaM cha bhImavikrAntaM prANebhyo.api priyaM mama |
arjunaM chendrasa~NkAshaM yamau tau cha yamopamau
shlokas.11:
draShTumichChAmi tAM chAhaM pA~nchAlIM dharmachAriNIm |
na cheha sthAtumichChAmi satyametadbravImi vaH
shlokas.12:
kiM me bhrAtRRivihInasya svargeNa surasattamAH |
yatra te sa mama svargo nAyaM svargo mato mama
shlokas.13:
devA UchuH||
yadi vai tatra te shraddhA gamyatAM putra mAchiram |
priye hi tava vartAmo devarAjasya shAsanAt
shlokas.14:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktvA taM tato devA devadUtamupAdishan |
yudhiShThirasya suhRRido darshayeti parantapa
shlokas.15:
tataH kuntIsuto rAjA devadUtashcha jagmatuH |
sahitau rAjashArdUla yatra te puruSharShabhAH
shlokas.16:
agrato devadUtastu yayau rAjA cha pRRiShThataH |
panthAnamashubhaM durgaM sevitaM pApakarmabhiH
shlokas.17:
tamasA sa.nvRRitaM ghoraM keshashaivalashAdvalam |
yuktaM pApakRRitAM gandhairmA.nsashoNitakardamam
shlokas.18:
da.nshotthAnaM sajhillIkaM makShikAmashakAvRRitam |
itashchetashcha kuNapaiH samantAtparivAritam
shlokas.21:
medorudhirayuktaishcha ChinnabAhUrupANibhiH |
nikRRittodarapAdaishcha tatra tatra praveritaiH
shlokas.22:
sa tatkuNapadurgandhamashivaM romaharShaNam |
jagAma rAjA dharmAtmA madhye bahu vichintayan
shlokas.23:
dadarshoShNodakaiH pUrNAM nadIM chApi sudurgamAm |
asipatravanaM chaiva nishitakShurasa.nvRRitam
shlokas.24:
karambhavAlukAstaptA AyasIshcha shilAH pRRithak |
lohakumbhIshcha tailasya kvAthyamAnAH samantataH
shlokas.25:
kUTashAlmalikaM chApi dusparshaM tIkShNakaNTakam |
dadarsha chApi kaunteyo yAtanAH pApakarmiNAm
shlokas.27:
kva cha te bhrAtaro mahyaM tanmamAkhyAtumarhasi |
desho.ayaM kashcha devAnAmetadichChAmi veditum
shlokas.28:
sa saMnivavRRite shrutvA dharmarAjasya bhAShitam |
devadUto.abravIchchainametAvadgamanaM tava
shlokas.29:
nivartitavyaM hi mayA tathAsmyukto divaukasaiH |
yadi shrAnto.asi rAjendra tvamathAgantumarhasi
shlokas.30:
yudhiShThirastu nirviNNastena gandhena mUrChitaH |
nivartane dhRRitamanAH paryAvartata bhArata
shlokas.31:
sa saMnivRRitto dharmAtmA duHkhashokasamanvitaH |
shushrAva tatra vadatAM dInA vAchaH samantataH
shlokas.32:
bho bho dharmaja rAjarShe puNyAbhijana pANDava |
anugrahArthamasmAkaM tiShTha tAvanmuhUrtakam
shlokas.33:
AyAti tvayi durdharShe vAti puNyaH samIraNaH |
tava gandhAnugastAta yenAsmAnsukhamAgamat
shlokas.34:
te vayaM pArtha dIrghasya kAlasya puruSharShabha |
sukhamAsAdayiShyAmastvAM dRRiShTvA rAjasattama
shlokas.35:
santiShThasva mahAbAho muhUrtamapi bhArata |
tvayi tiShThati kauravya yAtanAsmAnna bAdhate
shlokas.36:
evaM bahuvidhA vAchaH kRRipaNA vedanAvatAm |
tasmindeshe sa shushrAva samantAdvadatAM nRRipa
shlokas.37:
teShAM tadvachanaM shrutvA dayAvAndInabhAShiNAm |
aho kRRichChramiti prAha tasthau sa cha yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.38:
sa tA giraH purastAdvai shrutapUrvAH punaH punaH |
glAnAnAM duHkhitAnAM cha nAbhyajAnata pANDavaH
shlokas.39:
abudhyamAnastA vAcho dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH |
uvAcha ke bhavanto vai kimarthamiha tiShThatha
shlokas.40:
ityuktAste tataH sarve samantAdavabhAShire |
karNo.ahaM bhImaseno.ahamarjuno.ahamiti prabho
shlokas.41:
nakulaH sahadevo.ahaM dhRRiShTadyumno.ahamityuta |
draupadI draupadeyAshcha ityevaM te vichukrushuH
shlokas.42:
tA vAchaH sA tadA shrutvA taddeshasadRRishIrnRRipa |
tato vimamRRishe rAjA kiM nvidaM daivakAritam
shlokas.43:
kiM nu tatkaluShaM karma kRRitamebhirmahAtmabhiH |
karNena draupadeyairvA pA~nchAlyA vA sumadhyayA
shlokas.44:
ya ime pApagandhe.asmindeshe santi sudAruNe |
na hi jAnAmi sarveShAM duShkRRitaM puNyakarmaNAm
shlokas.45:
kiM kRRitvA dhRRitarAShTrasya putro rAjA suyodhanaH |
tathA shriyA yutaH pApaH saha sarvaiH padAnugaiH
shlokas.46:
mahendra iva lakShmIvAnAste paramapUjitaH |
kasyedAnIM vikAro.ayaM yadime narakaM gatAH
shlokas.47:
sarvadharmavidaH shUrAH satyAgamaparAyaNAH |
kShAtradharmaparAH prAj~nA yajvAno bhUridakShiNAH
shlokas.48:
kiM nu supto.asmi jAgarmi chetayAno na chetaye |
aho chittavikAro.ayaM syAdvA me chittavibhramaH
shlokas.50:
krodhamAhArayachchaiva tIvraM dharmasuto nRRipaH |
devA.nshcha garhayAmAsa dharmaM chaiva yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.51:
sa tIvragandhasantapto devadUtamuvAcha ha |
gamyatAM bhadra yeShAM tvaM dUtasteShAmupAntikam
shlokas.52:
na hyahaM tatra yAsmyAmi sthito.asmIti nivedyatAm |
matsa.nshrayAdime dUta sukhino bhrAtaro hi me
shlokas.53:
ityuktaH sa tadA dUtaH pANDuputreNa dhImatA |
jagAma tatra yatrAste devarAjaH shatakratuH
shlokas.54:
nivedayAmAsa cha taddharmarAjachikIrShitam |
yathoktaM dharmaputreNa sarvameva janAdhipa

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sthite muhUrtaM pArthe tu dharmarAje yudhiShThire |
Ajagmustatra kauravya devAH shakrapurogamAH
shlokas.2:
svayaM vigrahavAndharmo rAjAnaM prasamIkShitum |
tatrAjagAma yatrAsau kururAjo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.3:
teShu bhAsvaradeheShu puNyAbhijanakarmasu |
samAgateShu deveShu vyagamattattamo nRRipa
shlokas.4:
nAdRRishyanta cha tAstatra yAtanAH pApakarmiNAm |
nadI vaitaraNI chaiva kUTashAlmalinA saha
shlokas.5:
lohakumbhyaH shilAshchaiva nAdRRishyanta bhayAnakAH |
vikRRitAni sharIrANi yAni tatra samantataH
dadarsha rAjA kaunteyastAnyadRRishyAni chAbhavan
shlokas.6:
tato vAyuH sukhasparshaH puNyagandhavahaH shivaH |
vavau devasamIpasthaH shItalo.atIva bhArata
shlokas.7:
marutaH saha shakreNa vasavashchAshvinau saha |
sAdhyA rudrAstathAdityA ye chAnye.api divaukasaH
shlokas.8:
sarve tatra samAjagmuH siddhAshcha paramarShayaH |
yatra rAjA mahAtejA dharmaputraH sthito.abhavat
shlokas.9:
tataH shakraH surapatiH shriyA paramayA yutaH |
yudhiShThiramuvAchedaM sAntvapUrvamidaM vachaH
shlokas.10:
yudhiShThira mahAbAho prItA devagaNAstava |
ehyehi puruShavyAghra kRRitametAvatA vibho
siddhiH prAptA tvayA rAja.NllokAshchApyakShayAstava
shlokas.11:
na cha manyustvayA kAryaH shRRiNu chedaM vacho mama |
avashyaM narakastAta draShTavyaH sarvarAjabhiH
shlokas.12:
shubhAnAmashubhAnAM cha dvau rAshI puruSharShabha |
yaH pUrvaM sukRRitaM bhu~Nkte pashchAnnirayameti saH
pUrvaM narakabhAgyastu pashchAtsvargamupaiti saH
shlokas.13:
bhUyiShThaM pApakarmA yaH sa pUrvaM svargamashnute |
tena tvamevaM gamito mayA shreyorthinA nRRipa
shlokas.14:
vyAjena hi tvayA droNa upachIrNaH sutaM prati |
vyAjenaiva tato rAjandarshito narakastava
shlokas.15:
yathaiva tvaM tathA bhImastathA pArtho yamau tathA |
draupadI cha tathA kRRiShNA vyAjena narakaM gatAH
shlokas.16:
AgachCha narashArdUla muktAste chaiva kilbiShAt |
svapakShAshchaiva ye tubhyaM pArthivA nihatA raNe
sarve svargamanuprAptAstAnpashya puruSharShabha
shlokas.17:
karNashchaiva maheShvAsaH sarvashastrabhRRitAM varaH |
sa gataH paramAM siddhiM yadarthaM paritapyase
shlokas.18:
taM pashya puruShavyAghramAdityatanayaM vibho |
svasthAnasthaM mahAbAho jahi shokaM nararShabha
shlokas.19:
bhrAtR^I.nshchAnyA.nstathA pashya svapakShA.nshchaiva pArthivAn |
svaM svaM sthAnamanuprAptAnvyetu te mAnaso jvaraH
shlokas.20:
anubhUya pUrvaM tvaM kRRichChramitaH prabhRRiti kaurava |
viharasva mayA sArdhaM gatashoko nirAmayaH
shlokas.21:
karmaNAM tAta puNyAnAM jitAnAM tapasA svayam |
dAnAnAM cha mahAbAho phalaM prApnuhi pANDava
shlokas.22:
adya tvAM devagandharvA divyAshchApsaraso divi |
upasevantu kalyANaM virajombaravAsasaH
shlokas.23:
rAjasUyajitA.NllokAnashvamedhAbhivardhitAn |
prApnuhi tvaM mahAbAho tapasashcha phalaM mahat
shlokas.24:
uparyupari rAj~nAM hi tava lokA yudhiShThira |
harishchandrasamAH pArtha yeShu tvaM vihariShyasi
shlokas.25:
mAndhAtA yatra rAjarShiryatra rAjA bhagIrathaH |
dauHShantiryatra bharatastatra tvaM vihariShyasi
shlokas.26:
eShA devanadI puNyA pArtha trailokyapAvanI |
AkAshaga~NgA rAjendra tatrAplutya gamiShyasi
shlokas.27:
atra snAtasya te bhAvo mAnuSho vigamiShyati |
gatashoko nirAyAso muktavairo bhaviShyasi
shlokas.28:
evaM bruvati devendre kauravendraM yudhiShThiram |
dharmo vigrahavAnsAkShAduvAcha sutamAtmanaH
shlokas.29:
bho bho rAjanmahAprAj~na prIto.asmi tava putraka |
madbhaktyA satyavAkyena kShamayA cha damena cha
shlokas.30:
eShA tRRitIyA jij~nAsA tava rAjankRRitA mayA |
na shakyase chAlayituM svabhAvAtpArtha hetubhiH
shlokas.31:
pUrvaM parIkShito hi tvamAsIrdvaitavanaM prati |
araNIsahitasyArthe tachcha nistIrNavAnasi
shlokas.32:
sodaryeShu vinaShTeShu draupadyAM tatra bhArata |
shvarUpadhAriNA putra punastvaM me parIkShitaH
shlokas.33:
idaM tRRitIyaM bhrAtR^INAmarthe yatsthAtumichChasi |
vishuddho.asi mahAbhAga sukhI vigatakalmaShaH
shlokas.34:
na cha te bhrAtaraH pArtha narakasthA vishAM pate |
mAyaiShA devarAjena mahendreNa prayojitA
shlokas.35:
avashyaM narakastAta draShTavyaH sarvarAjabhiH |
tatastvayA prAptamidaM muhUrtaM duHkhamuttamam
shlokas.36:
na savyasAchI bhImo vA yamau vA puruSharShabhau |
karNo vA satyavAkShUro narakArhAshchiraM nRRipa
shlokas.37:
na kRRiShNA rAjaputrI cha narakArhA yudhiShThira |
ehyehi bharatashreShTha pashya ga~NgAM trilokagAm
shlokas.38:
evamuktaH sa rAjarShistava pUrvapitAmahaH |
jagAma saha dharmeNa sarvaishcha tridashAlayaiH
shlokas.39:
ga~NgAM devanadIM puNyAM pAvanImRRiShisa.nstutAm |
avagAhya tu tAM rAjA tanuM tatyAja mAnuShIm
shlokas.40:
tato divyavapurbhUtvA dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
nirvairo gatasantApo jale tasminsamAplutaH
shlokas.41:
tato yayau vRRito devaiH kururAjo yudhiShThiraH |
dharmeNa sahito dhImAnstUyamAno maharShibhiH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA devaiH sarShimarudgaNaiH |
pUjyamAno yayau tatra yatra te kurupu~NgavAH
shlokas.2:
dadarsha tatra govindaM brAhmeNa vapuShAnvitam |
tenaiva dRRiShTapUrveNa sAdRRishyenopasUchitam
shlokas.3:
dIpyamAnaM svavapuShA divyairastrairupasthitam |
chakraprabhRRitibhirghorairdivyaiH puruShavigrahaiH
upAsyamAnaM vIreNa phalgunena suvarchasA
shlokas.4:
aparasminnathoddeshe karNaM shastrabhRRitAM varam |
dvAdashAdityasahitaM dadarsha kurunandanaH
shlokas.6:
ashvinostu tathA sthAne dIpyamAnau svatejasA |
nakulaM sahadevaM cha dadarsha kurunandanaH
shlokas.7:
tathA dadarsha pA~nchAlIM kamalotpalamAlinIm |
vapuShA svargamAkramya tiShThantImarkavarchasam
shlokas.8:
athainAM sahasA rAjA praShTumaichChadyudhiShThiraH |
tato.asya bhagavAnindraH kathayAmAsa devarAT
shlokas.9:
shrIreShA draupadIrUpA tvadarthe mAnuShaM gatA |
ayonijA lokakAntA puNyagandhA yudhiShThira
shlokas.10:
drupadasya kule jAtA bhavadbhishchopajIvitA |
ratyarthaM bhavatAM hyeShA nirmitA shUlapANinA
shlokas.11:
ete pa~ncha mahAbhAgA gandharvAH pAvakaprabhAH |
draupadyAstanayA rAjanyuShmAkamamitaujasaH
shlokas.12:
pashya gandharvarAjAnaM dhRRitarAShTraM manIShiNam |
enaM cha tvaM vijAnIhi bhrAtaraM pUrvajaM pituH
shlokas.13:
ayaM te pUrvajo bhrAtA kaunteyaH pAvakadyutiH |
sUryaputro.agrajaH shreShTho rAdheya iti vishrutaH
Adityasahito yAti pashyainaM puruSharShabha
shlokas.14:
sAdhyAnAmatha devAnAM vasUnAM marutAmapi |
gaNeShu pashya rAjendra vRRiShNyandhakamahArathAn
sAtyakipramukhAnvIrAnbhojA.nshchaiva mahArathAn
shlokas.15:
somena sahitaM pashya saubhadramaparAjitam |
abhimanyuM maheShvAsaM nishAkarasamadyutim
shlokas.16:
eSha pANDurmaheShvAsaH kuntyA mAdryA cha sa~NgataH |
vimAnena sadAbhyeti pitA tava mamAntikam
shlokas.17:
vasubhiH sahitaM pashya bhIShmaM shAntanavaM nRRipam |
droNaM bRRihaspateH pArshve gurumenaM nishAmaya
shlokas.18:
ete chAnye mahIpAlA yodhAstava cha pANDava |
gandharvaiH sahitA yAnti yakShaiH puNyajanaistathA
shlokas.19:
guhyakAnAM gatiM chApi kechitprAptA nRRisattamAH |
tyaktvA dehaM jitasvargAH puNyavAgbuddhikarmabhiH

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
bhIShmadroNau mahAtmAnau dhRRitarAShTrashcha pArthivaH |
virATadrupadau chobhau sha~NkhashchaivottarastathA
shlokas.2:
dhRRiShTaketurjayatseno rAjA chaiva sa satyajit |
duryodhanasutAshchaiva shakunishchaiva saubalaH
shlokas.3:
karNaputrAshcha vikrAntA rAjA chaiva jayadrathaH |
ghaTotkachAdayashchaiva ye chAnye nAnukIrtitAH
shlokas.4:
ye chAnye kIrtitAstatra rAjAno dIptamUrtayaH |
svarge kAlaM kiyantaM te tasthustadapi sha.nsa me
shlokas.5:
Aho svichChAshvataM sthAnaM teShAM tatra dvijottama |
ante vA karmaNaH kAM te gatiM prAptA nararShabhAH
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM prochyamAnaM tvayA dvija
shlokas.6:
sUta uvAcha||
ityuktaH sa tu viprarShiranuj~nAto mahAtmanA |
vyAsena tasya nRRipaterAkhyAtumupachakrame
shlokas.7:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
gantavyaM karmaNAmante sarveNa manujAdhipa |
shRRiNu guhyamidaM rAjandevAnAM bharatarShabha
yaduvAcha mahAtejA divyachakShuH pratApavAn
shlokas.8:
muniH purANaH kauravya pArAsharyo mahAvrataH |
agAdhabuddhiH sarvaj~no gatij~naH sarvakarmaNAm
shlokas.9:
vasUneva mahAtejA bhIShmaH prApa mahAdyutiH |
aShTAveva hi dRRishyante vasavo bharatarShabha
shlokas.10:
bRRihaspatiM viveshAtha droNo hya~NgirasAM varam |
kRRitavarmA tu hArdikyaH pravivesha marudgaNam
shlokas.11:
sanatkumAraM pradyumnaH pravivesha yathAgatam |
dhRRitarAShTro dhaneshasya lokAnprApa durAsadAn
shlokas.12:
dhRRitarAShTreNa sahitA gAndhArI cha yashasvinI |
patnIbhyAM sahitaH pANDurmahendrasadanaM yayau
shlokas.13:
virATadrupadau chobhau dhRRiShTaketushcha pArthivaH |
nishaThAkrUrasAmbAshcha bhAnuH kampo viDUrathaH
shlokas.14:
bhUrishravAH shalashchaiva bhUrishcha pRRithivIpatiH |
ugrasenastathA ka.nso vasudevashcha vIryavAn
shlokas.15:
uttarashcha saha bhrAtrA sha~Nkhena narapu~NgavaH |
vishveShAM devatAnAM te vivishurnarasattamAH
shlokas.16:
varchA nAma mahAtejAH somaputraH pratApavAn |
so.abhimanyurnRRisiMhasya phalgunasya suto.abhavat
shlokas.17:
sa yuddhvA kShatradharmeNa yathA nAnyaH pumAnkvachit |
vivesha somaM dharmAtmA karmaNo.ante mahArathaH
shlokas.18:
Avivesha raviM karNaH pitaraM puruSharShabha |
dvAparaM shakuniH prApa dhRRiShTadyumnastu pAvakam
shlokas.19:
dhRRitarAShTrAtmajAH sarve yAtudhAnA balotkaTAH |
RRiddhimanto mahAtmAnaH shastrapUtA divaM gatAH
dharmamevAvishatkShattA rAjA chaiva yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.20:
ananto bhagavAndevaH pravivesha rasAtalam |
pitAmahaniyogAddhi yo yogAdgAmadhArayat
shlokas.21:
ShoDashastrIsahasrANi vAsudevaparigrahaH |
nyamajjanta sarasvatyAM kAlena janamejaya
tAshchApyapsaraso bhUtvA vAsudevamupAgaman
shlokas.22:
hatAstasminmahAyuddhe ye vIrAstu mahArathAH |
ghaTotkachAdayaH sarve devAnyakShA.nshcha bhejire
shlokas.23:
duryodhanasahAyAshcha rAkShasAH parikIrtitAH |
prAptAste kramasho rAjansarvalokAnanuttamAn
shlokas.24:
bhavanaM cha mahendrasya kuberasya cha dhImataH |
varuNasya tathA lokAnvivishuH puruSharShabhAH
shlokas.25:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM vistareNa mahAdyute |
kurUNAM charitaM kRRitsnaM pANDavAnAM cha bhArata
shlokas.26:
sUta uvAcha||
etachChrutvA dvijashreShThAtsa rAjA janamejayaH |
vismito.abhavadatyarthaM yaj~nakarmAntareShvatha
shlokas.27:
tataH samApayAmAsuH karma tattasya yAjakAH |
AstIkashchAbhavatprItaH parimokShya bhuja~NgamAn
shlokas.28:
tato dvijAtInsarvA.nstAndakShiNAbhiratoShayat |
pUjitAshchApi te rAj~nA tato jagmuryathAgatam
shlokas.29:
visarjayitvA viprA.nstAnrAjApi janamejayaH |
tatastakShashilAyAH sa punarAyAdgajAhvayam
shlokas.30:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM vaishampAyanakIrtitam |
vyAsAj~nayA samAkhyAtaM sarpasatre nRRipasya ha
shlokas.31:
puNyo.ayamitihAsAkhyaH pavitraM chedamuttamam |
kRRiShNena muninA vipra niyataM satyavAdinA
shlokas.32:
sarvaj~nena vidhij~nena dharmaj~nAnavatA satA |
atIndriyeNa shuchinA tapasA bhAvitAtmanA
shlokas.33:
aishvarye vartatA chaiva sA~NkhyayogavidA tathA |
naikatantravibuddhena dRRiShTvA divyena chakShuShA
shlokas.34:
kIrtiM prathayatA loke pANDavAnAM mahAtmanAm |
anyeShAM kShatriyANAM cha bhUridraviNatejasAm
shlokas.35:
ya idaM shrAvayedvidvAnsadA parvaNi parvaNi |
dhUtapApmA jitasvargo brahmabhUyAya gachChati
shlokas.36:
yashchedaM shrAvayechChrAddhe brAhmaNAnpAdamantataH |
akShayyamannapAnaM vai pitR^I.nstasyopatiShThate
shlokas.37:
ahnA yadenaH kurute indriyairmanasApi vA |
mahAbhAratamAkhyAya pashchAtsandhyAM pramuchyate
shlokas.38:
dharme chArthe cha kAme cha mokShe cha bharatarShabha |
yadihAsti tadanyatra yannehAsti na tatkvachit
shlokas.39:
jayo nAmetihAso.ayaM shrotavyo bhUtimichChatA |
rAj~nA rAjasutaishchApi garbhiNyA chaiva yoShitA
shlokas.40:
svargakAmo labhetsvargaM jayakAmo labhejjayam |
garbhiNI labhate putraM kanyAM vA bahubhAginIm
shlokas.41:
anAgataM tribhirvarShaiH kRRiShNadvaipAyanaH prabhuH |
sa.ndarbhaM bhAratasyAsya kRRitavAndharmakAmyayA
shlokas.42:
nArado.ashrAvayaddevAnasito devalaH pitR^In |
rakSho yakShA~nshuko martyAnvaishampAyana eva tu
shlokas.43:
itihAsamimaM puNyaM mahArthaM vedasaMmitam |
shrAvayedyastu varNA.nstrInkRRitvA brAhmaNamagrataH
shlokas.44:
sa naraH pApanirmuktaH kIrtiM prApyeha shaunaka |
gachChetparamikAM siddhimatra me nAsti sa.nshayaH
shlokas.47:
mAtApitRRisahasrANi putradArashatAni cha |
sa.nsAreShvanubhUtAni yAnti yAsyanti chApare
shlokas.48:
harShasthAnasahasrANi bhayasthAnashatAni cha |
divase divase mUDhamAvishanti na paNDitam
shlokas.49:
UrdhvabAhurviraumyeSha na cha kashchichChRRiNoti me |
dharmAdarthashcha kAmashcha sa kimarthaM na sevyate
shlokas.50:
na jAtu kAmAnna bhayAnna lobhA;ddharmaM tyajejjIvitasyApi hetoH |
nityo dharmaH sukhaduHkhe tvanitye; jIvo nityo heturasya tvanityaH
shlokas.51:
imAM bhAratasAvitrIM prAtarutthAya yaH paThet |
sa bhArataphalaM prApya paraM brahmAdhigachChati
shlokas.52:
yathA samudro bhagavAnyathA cha himavAngiriH |
khyAtAvubhau ratnanidhI tathA bhAratamuchyate
shlokas.53:
mahAbhAratamAkhyAnaM yaH paThetsusamAhitaH |
sa gachChetparamAM siddhimiti me nAsti sa.nshayaH
shlokas.54:
dvaipAyanoShThapuTaniHsRRitamaprameyaM; puNyaM pavitramatha pApaharaM shivaM cha |
yo bhArataM samadhigachChati vAchyamAnaM; kiM tasya puShkarajalairabhiShechanena
